name: Lightspeed Retail (X-Series)
description: Lightspeed Retail X-Series (formerly Vend) point of sale: outlets, registers, sales search by date, products and product families, categories, brands, suppliers, price books and promotions, stock levels, adjustments, consignments and purchase orders, customers, store credit and gift cards.
instructions:
## Lightspeed Retail (X-Series)
This connector uses the **Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) API** (formerly Vend), date version `2026-10`, of one store: `https://<domain_prefix>.retail.lightspeed.app/api/2026-10`. It reads outlets, registers, payment types, taxes, staff and shifts; the catalog (products and product families, categories, brands, tags, suppliers, price books, promotions); stock levels, stock adjustments, consignments and purchase orders; sales; customers, customer groups, store credit and gift cards. It can create and update products, customers, suppliers, consignments and stock adjustments and record sales. It does not cover Lightspeed Retail R-Series or Lightspeed Restaurant, which have other APIs.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Personal tokens need the Plus plan or above. As an admin open the Retail POS back office, **Setup**, **Personal tokens**, click **Add personal token**, give it a name (and, if you like, an expiry date), generate it and copy the token.
2. Paste it into `LIGHTSPEED_PERSONAL_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and acts as the user who created it.
3. Set `LIGHTSPEED_DOMAIN_PREFIX` to the first part of your store address: for `https://mystore.retail.lightspeed.app` it is `mystore`.
4. Run `lightspeed_retail_get_retailer` to check the setup.

**Workflow**
- Store setup: `lightspeed_retail_get_retailer`, `lightspeed_retail_get_current_user`, `lightspeed_retail_list_outlets`, `lightspeed_retail_get_outlet`, `lightspeed_retail_list_registers`, `lightspeed_retail_get_register`, `lightspeed_retail_get_register_payments_summary` (till totals of the open shift), `lightspeed_retail_list_payment_types`, `lightspeed_retail_list_taxes`, `lightspeed_retail_get_tax`, `lightspeed_retail_list_users`, `lightspeed_retail_get_user`, `lightspeed_retail_list_shifts`.
- Sales: for a period, a register, a customer or an invoice number use `lightspeed_retail_search` with `type: sales` and `date_from`/`date_to` (the plain list ignores dates). `lightspeed_retail_list_sales` walks all sales by version (for syncing), `lightspeed_retail_get_sale` reads one. `lightspeed_retail_create_sale` records a sale, `lightspeed_retail_update_sale` changes or completes a parked one, `lightspeed_retail_return_sale` starts a return.
- Catalog: `lightspeed_retail_list_products` (or `sku` for one product), `lightspeed_retail_get_product`, `lightspeed_retail_get_product_family`, `lightspeed_retail_get_product_family_of_product`. Since 2026-10 a product family holds the shared data (name, brand, category, tags) and each product the per-variant data (codes, prices, suppliers): create with `lightspeed_retail_create_product_family`, add variants with `lightspeed_retail_add_products_to_family`, change shared data with `lightspeed_retail_update_product_family` and per-product data with `lightspeed_retail_update_product`; `lightspeed_retail_delete_product` removes one product. Reference data: `lightspeed_retail_list_product_categories`, `lightspeed_retail_list_product_types`, `lightspeed_retail_list_brands`, `lightspeed_retail_list_tags`, `lightspeed_retail_list_suppliers`, `lightspeed_retail_get_supplier`, `lightspeed_retail_create_supplier`, `lightspeed_retail_list_price_books`, `lightspeed_retail_list_promotions`, `lightspeed_retail_get_promotion`.
- Stock: `lightspeed_retail_list_inventory_levels` (per outlet, filter and sort; `to_be_procured_only` for reorder lists), `lightspeed_retail_get_product_inventory_levels`, `lightspeed_retail_list_inventory_records`, `lightspeed_retail_list_stock_adjustments`, `lightspeed_retail_create_stock_adjustments`. Orders, transfers and stocktakes: `lightspeed_retail_list_consignments`, `lightspeed_retail_get_consignment`, `lightspeed_retail_list_consignment_products`, `lightspeed_retail_create_consignment`, `lightspeed_retail_list_purchase_orders`, `lightspeed_retail_get_purchase_order`.
- Customers: find one with `lightspeed_retail_search` (`type: customers`, `email` or names), then `lightspeed_retail_get_customer`; `lightspeed_retail_list_customers`, `lightspeed_retail_create_customer`, `lightspeed_retail_update_customer`, `lightspeed_retail_delete_customer`, `lightspeed_retail_list_customer_groups`, `lightspeed_retail_get_customer_store_credit`. Gift cards: `lightspeed_retail_list_gift_cards`, `lightspeed_retail_get_gift_card`.

**Switched off at install**: `lightspeed_retail_return_sale`, `lightspeed_retail_delete_product` and `lightspeed_retail_delete_customer`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.

**Before writing**: sales, returns and stock adjustments change stock and the reports at once; show the user the lines and totals and wait for a yes. `lightspeed_retail_update_sale` replaces the whole sale.

**Reading the answers**: answers wrap records in `data`. Ids are UUIDs. Money is a decimal number in the store currency. A sale has `totals` (`price` excluding tax, `tax`, `price_incl_tax`); on each line `pricing.price` is the unit price excluding tax, `pricing.total` the line total after discount, `pricing.cost_total` the cost, and `tax.amount` and `tax.total` the unit and line tax. Tax rates are fractions (0.2 = 20%). Times are UTC (ISO 8601); `date_from`/`date_to` take UTC, `time_from`/`time_to` local time with `timezone`. A sale `state` is closed, parked, pending (on account or layby) or voided.

**Paging**: most lists page by version: the answer has `version: {min, max}`; pass `max` as `after` for the next page and stop when `data` is empty. `lightspeed_retail_search` and `lightspeed_retail_list_inventory_levels` page with `offset`; gift cards with `before`.

**Limits and errors**: about 300 requests per 5 minutes per register plus 50 (429 with `Retry-After`). 401 means a wrong or expired token or a wrong domain prefix, 403 a user without the right (personal tokens act as their user), 404 a wrong id, 422 a validation error with the field named.
prerequisites: A Lightspeed Retail X-Series store on the Plus plan or above (for personal tokens) and an admin user who creates a personal token.

LIGHTSPEED_DOMAIN_PREFIX.label: Store domain prefix
LIGHTSPEED_DOMAIN_PREFIX.help: The first part of your store address: for https://mystore.retail.lightspeed.app enter mystore.
LIGHTSPEED_DOMAIN_PREFIX.patternMessage: Enter only the prefix, e.g. mystore, without https:// and without .retail.lightspeed.app.

LIGHTSPEED_PERSONAL_TOKEN.label: Personal token
LIGHTSPEED_PERSONAL_TOKEN.help: Retail POS, Setup, Personal tokens: add a token (admin users, Plus plan and above) and copy it.
LIGHTSPEED_PERSONAL_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces, quotes or a Bearer prefix.

verifyHints.401: Lightspeed refused the personal token. Check that it was copied whole, has not expired and belongs to the store in LIGHTSPEED_DOMAIN_PREFIX.
verifyHints.403: The token works but its user may not do this. Personal tokens act as the admin who created them; create the token with an admin user.
verifyHints.404: No store answered at this address. Check LIGHTSPEED_DOMAIN_PREFIX: only the part before .retail.lightspeed.app.
verifyHints.429: Lightspeed rate limit reached (about 300 requests per 5 minutes per register). Wait a few minutes and try again.
